title: Package RAPL reads 12.5 W under all-core load on a 120 W CPU

owner.description: Unknown: board VR current report, PCU configuration, or CPU

description: Package RAPL reads 12.5 W with 28 threads loaded and every core at ratio 29, and 3.4 W idle, on a 120 W-TDP CPU. The energy unit is the standard 2^-14 J and powercap matches MSR 611. HWiNFO shows the same wrong value, per the user. PL1 120 W and PL2 144 W compare against this reading, so they should never engage. SVID Support 168D is 1 in every saved record of the 6 November dump, and MSR 601 is 0x10141480000470 (current limit 142 A).
not_established: True draw is unmeasured. RAPL on Haswell-EP is measured, not modelled; whether its input is the mainboard VR's current report and whether firmware can rescale it are both unverified. No IMON or ICCMAX strings exist in the extracted modules.
remediation: None yet. Needs a wall-meter reference, the measurement path for this CPU family, and a search of PpmInitialize and UncoreInitPeim for VR current scaling. C3.
